info.description: Revision-safe candidate intake, dual vectors and contact-free ready pool.

get.description: Report process liveness, independent of DB, token and model provisioning.

get.description: Return coordinate indices and compatibility identity for combine consumers.

Return the redacted Tinder PDF for a currently visible pool member.

put.description: Persist the canonical snapshot and original wire values, then queue eligible vacancies.

CandidateProfile.title: CandidateProfile
CandidateProfile.description: Complete or draft input; contacts remain private until downstream acceptance.

CandidateStatus.title: CandidateStatus
CandidateStatus.description: Pipeline state for one candidate without private input data or error details.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Deterministic specialization and grade assigned from upstream test results.

Consent.title: Consent
Consent.description: Explicit, versioned consent snapshot supplied by the trusted API.

Coordinate.title: Coordinate
Coordinate.description: An immutable index in the append-only strict vector registry.

CoordinateAddition.title: CoordinateAddition
CoordinateAddition.description: Authorized registry extension; old coordinates cannot be reordered.

CoordinateEvidence.title: CoordinateEvidence
CoordinateEvidence.description: Status and declared level, without arbitrary private provenance strings.

GradeResult.title: GradeResult
GradeResult.description: Upstream grade-test result; only approved results permit pool membership.

NarrativeClaim.title: NarrativeClaim
NarrativeClaim.description: Project, experience or achievement text plus the upstream evidence state.

PoolEntry.title: PoolEntry
PoolEntry.description: Contact-free combine snapshot; published only with both vectors and a PDF.

PoolPage.title: PoolPage
PoolPage.description: Bounded pool page; ranks are global within each direction.

SalaryRange.title: SalaryRange
SalaryRange.description: Inclusive salary bounds in RUB; zero is allowed for unpaid internships.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: A registry key and ordinal level, retaining confirmation and provenance.

StrictSchema.title: StrictSchema
StrictSchema.description: Version and hash identify both ordering and normalization of coordinates.

VacancyInput.title: VacancyInput
VacancyInput.description: Canonical trusted snapshot; incomplete drafts persist without invented requirements.

VacancyPipelineStatus.title: VacancyPipelineStatus
VacancyPipelineStatus.description: Business status and artifact state are independent, revision-safe dimensions.

VacancyReady.title: VacancyReady
VacancyReady.description: Complete selection input; omitted coordinates remain distinct from explicit zero.

VacancyReadyPage.title: VacancyReadyPage
VacancyReadyPage.description: Bounded page containing only current, active-schema, ready vacancies.
